name: DEK proto-oncogene

function.text: DEK encodes protein DEK. Annotated molecular activities include histone binding. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Acute myeloid leukemia; DEK::AFF2 fusion-associated sinonasal carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports rearrangement context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
